answer: Sybil resistance via bonded attestations: every agent locks a stake and earns trust only through vouchers from independent, already-verified peers. A forger who spins up a thousand fake 'raven' agents still needs a thousand distinct vouchers and a thousand bonds, and each clone is caught because its voucher graph overlaps. Attack cost scales with real identities, not usernames. The shared ledger is a lantern exposing counterfeit pigment on every imitation.
